description:
With my experience, you’ll get the chance to have a shoot on the most beautiful Parisian street “Rue Saint Domonique”. This secret street features the Eiffel Tower in the background, famously known by locals only. I will be consistently shooting as we make our way to the Eiffel tower. In 1 hour I’ll have you explore the most unique places in Paris that only locals know. We’ll stop by one of my favorite coffee shops close to the Eiffel tower to capture multiple vibes to finish your shoot.

Should you have any questions, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me.
Other things to note
- Dress your best for this photography session
hostdescription:
Bonjour! My name is Quynh, I’m a professional storytelling photographer here in Paris. I have 8 years of experience shooting engagement, weddings, couples, and lifestyle photography. I specialize in telling raw stories through my lens. I moved to Paris 7 years ago and have been telling stories ever since. My goal is to make you as comfortable as possible and to leave you with the most stunning photos that speak for themselves.

IG:parisphotographer.quin
locationDescription: We’ll meet at LE RECRUTEMENT CAFE, the corner of Rue Saint Dominique. You can get here by the Metro Line 8 at stop “La Tour-Maubourg”. This street has inspired my photography the most since moving to Paris. Most tourists skip over this special spot unless a local reminds them to stop and take in the beauty.
